note: Measured command counts per Llama-3.2-3B prefill layer (S=128). cost.analyze by_role. Reuse these instead of re-compiling. Update only when the compiler changes.

hf_before_isa.desc: HF import path, best mode (pack+reuse+fuse), OLD ISA (pre-0710 retarget: element-copy transpose, ones-matmul reduce/broadcast, add-based K-accum, 5-op SiLU). RoPE on HF path = slice/concat (fed cos/sin).

hf_after_retarget.desc: HF import path, best mode, AFTER Phase-2 retarget (transpose->strided, native reduce, MAC, native SiLU). NOTE: HF path feeds cos/sin and uses slice/concat rotate_half, so it does NOT exercise our RoPE (sign-inv + on-device cos/sin).

manual_perm_rope.desc: manual build_prefill_layer_module, packed, AFTER Phase-2 retarget but RoPE STILL permutation-matmul (i.e. before the RoPE change). Exercises our reduce/transpose/MAC/SiLU.

manual_signinv_rope.desc: manual build_prefill_layer_module, packed, AFTER FULL retarget incl. RoPE (sign-inversion rotate_half + on-device pos-based cos/sin). This is the current HEAD.

manual_old_isa.desc: manual build_prefill_layer_module, packed, OLD ISA (commit 3e0638f: element-copy transpose, ones-matmul reduce/broadcast, add-based K-accum, 5-op SiLU, permutation-matmul RoPE). Same generation path as manual_signinv_rope, so a manual_old_isa vs manual_signinv_rope comparison reflects the RoPE change (permutation-matmul -> sign-inv+on-device).

unpacked_note.desc: For reference: WITHOUT weight packing, the HF prefill layer is 14,818,383 cmds, gather 88.1%, useful 5.7% (analyze_kernels default). Packing is what makes the real path 6.6x smaller.
